tool.name: StORF-Reporter augment
tool.command: mkdir -p results && storf augment --input '$gff' --fasta '$fasta' --outdir results --genetic-code '$genetic_code' --min-orf '$min_orf' --max-orf '$max_orf' --gene-ident '$gene_ident' --primary-tier '$primary_tier' --gff-coordinate-mode '$gff_coordinate_mode' --overlap-coordinate-basis '$overlap_coordinate_basis' #if $include_consecutive --include-consecutive #end if #if $include_first_stop --include-first-stop #end if #if $remove_inframe_stops --remove-inframe-stops #end if --protein-coordinate-mode '$protein_coordinate_mode' #if str($promote) != 'none' --promote-cds '$promote' #else --no-promote-cds #end if --overwrite

param.name: gene_ident
param.label: Annotated-region selector
param.help: Use exact comma-separated feature types, Prokka/Bakta, or ID=gene for Ensembl attribute matching.

param.name: primary_tier
param.label: Lowest tier included in primary outputs
param.option: medium and high; exploratory in review files
high only; lower tiers in review files

param.name: include_first_stop
param.label: Include upstream delimiting stop
param.help: Include the first stop codon in candidate GFF3 columns and nucleotide FASTA.

param.name: remove_inframe_stops
param.label: Remove internal stop symbols from protein FASTA
param.help: Removes * from protein output only; nucleotide loci are unchanged.

param.name: include_consecutive
param.label: Enable competing Con-StORFs
param.help: Maximal multi-stop Con-StORFs enter the same overlap ranking and can replace ordinary StORFs.

param.name: promote
param.label: Minimum tier promoted to CDS
param.option: do not promote; retain candidates as ORFs

tool.help: Evidence scores are prioritisation heuristics, not calibrated gene probabilities. CDS promotion additionally requires complete-ORF structural validation. The output collection includes augmented and UR GFF3/FASTA, TSV, HTML, validation JSON, and manifest files. Candidates are coordinate-interleaved in the augmented GFF3; calls below the selected primary tier are preserved in separate review files. The annotated-region selector accepts exact feature types, the Prokka/Bakta alias, or an attribute-prefix query such as ID=gene.
